verses.text: ‘Don’t spread a false report. Don’t join with wicked people to give dishonest testimony. ⚖️
‘Don’t follow a crowd into wrongdoing. Don’t give testimony in court just to side with the majority and twist justice. ⚖️
‘Don’t show favoritism to a poor person in a legal case. ⚖️
‘If you find your enemy’s ox or donkey wandering off, take it back to them. 🐂
‘If you see the donkey of someone who hates you collapsed under its load, don’t walk away. Help lift it back up. 🫏
‘Don’t deny justice to poor people when they bring a case. ⚖️
‘Stay far away from false accusations. Don’t kill innocent and honest people, because I won’t declare the guilty innocent. ⚖️
‘Don’t take a bribe. A bribe blinds people who can see and twists the words of honest people. 🚫
‘Don’t oppress a foreigner. You know what it feels like to be a foreigner, because you were foreigners in Egypt. 🤝
‘Sow your land for six years and gather its crops, 🌾
‘but in the seventh year, leave it unplanted and let it rest. Then poor people can eat from it, and wild animals can eat whatever remains. Do the same with your vineyards and olive groves. 🌱
‘Work for six days, but rest on the seventh, so your ox and donkey can rest, and your servant’s son and the foreigner living among you can be refreshed. 🛌
‘Be careful to follow everything I’ve told you. Don’t even speak the names of other gods or let them be heard from your mouth. 🙏
‘Celebrate a festival for me three times each year. 🎉

‘Celebrate the Festival of Unleavened Bread. As I commanded, eat unleavened bread for seven days at the appointed time in Abib, because you came out of Egypt in that month. No one may come before me empty-handed. 🍞
‘Also celebrate the Festival of Harvest with the first produce from your work in the fields, and the Festival of Ingathering at the end of the year, when you bring in what you’ve grown. 🌾
‘Three times each year, every male must appear before me, Yahweh God. 🙏
‘Don’t offer the blood of my sacrifice with bread made with yeast. Don’t leave the fat from my festival sacrifice until morning. 🔥
‘Bring the first and best of your soil’s produce into the house of Yahweh your God. Don’t boil a young goat in its mother’s milk. 🍇
‘Look, I’m sending an angel ahead of you to guard you on the way and bring you to the place I’ve prepared. 👼
‘Pay attention to him and listen to what he says. Don’t rebel against him; he won’t forgive your rebellion, because my name is in him. ⚠️
‘But if you carefully listen to his voice and do everything I say, I’ll oppose your enemies and fight those who fight you. 🛡️
‘My angel will go ahead of you and bring you to the Amorites, Hittites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hivites, and Jebusites. I’ll wipe them out. 🗺️
‘Don’t bow down to their gods, serve them, or copy their practices. Tear their idols down and smash their sacred pillars. 🚫
‘Serve Yahweh your God. He’ll bless your food and water and remove sickness from among you. 🍞
‘No woman in your land will miscarry or be unable to have children. I’ll let you live out your full lifespan. 🕊️
‘I’ll send dread ahead of you, throw every nation you meet into confusion, and make all your enemies turn and run. 🛡️
‘I’ll send hornets ahead of you to drive the Hivites, Canaanites, and Hittites out before you. 🐝
‘I won’t drive them out in a single year, or the land would become empty and wild animals would multiply against you. 🐾
‘I’ll drive them out little by little, until your people grow in number and can take possession of the land. 🌱
‘I’ll set your borders from the Red Sea to the Sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River. I’ll hand the land’s people over to you, and you’ll drive them out. 🗺️
‘Don’t make a covenant with them or with their gods. ⚠️
‘Don’t let them live in your land, or they may lead you to sin against me. If you serve their gods, it’ll become a trap for you.’ ⚠️
